meta.title: Add TS benchmark via compiler
meta.body_summary: Add a Mochi-to-TypeScript compilation step to the benchmark runner and remove manually written TypeScript template files, instead running benchmarks via Deno on compiler-generated output.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit tooling addition replaces manual TS templates with compiler-generated benchmarks; merged instantly by author without review or performance evidence.

core_change_summary.description: Modified bench/runner.go to compile Mochi code to TypeScript and then run the generated TS benchmarks via Deno, while removing all pre-existing hand-written TypeScript templates under bench/template/math/.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The seven removed files were hand-coded TypeScript implementations of math algorithms; they are replaced by compiler-generated output.
